snippet.title: INFERIUS Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist INFERIUS on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2470790/INFERIUS

INFERIUS is a first-person psychological horror roguelite deckbuilder that drags you through a nightmarish reimagining of Dante’s Inferno. Armed only with a fragile lantern and a deck of evolving Tarot-inspired cards, you’ll descend through nine dominions of Hell, facing grotesque rulers in strategic card duels where every move risks your soul. Each victory unlocks new powers, each death reshapes the world, the story, and your sanity. Every run is different, every choice matters, and the only way out is through.

Sign up for our beta & follow development on our socials: https://lucidrainstudios.com

#INFERIUS #Gaming
